The console has visible scratches and scuffs on the top surface and sides.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models, with no visible damage.
The console is placed upright, with the disc drive visible on the right side.
The background is a concrete wall, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
There is a watermark 'MISHA JEREMIAH' across the image.

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the console and controllers, but no proof of functionality or condition beyond surface appearance. The term 'Fat' likely refers to the console model, which is visible, but 'Good Condition' is subjective and not verifiable from the photo alone.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controllers may not function properly (e.g., no battery, damaged buttons, or connectivity issues)
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs (e.g., button presses, analog stick movement).

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console and a verification check via PlayStation Network or official Sony website.
risks.if_unproven: priced with discount for potential legal or warranty issues

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and functioning.
Photo of the serial number on the back of the console.
Proof of warranty or official receipt if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
